name: B10-0581/2025 (ECR) – Arbitrary arrest and sentencing of academics Bahruz Samadov and Igbal Abilov in Azerbaijan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arbitrary arrest and sentencing of academics Bahruz Samadov and Igbal Abilov in Azerbaijan
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Azerbaijan to free two academics, Bahruz Samadov and Igbal Abilov, who were held for over a year over their research and criticism. Samadov was sentenced to 15 years for high treason. The Parliament also asks Azerbaijan to stop treating academic work and peaceful criticism as threats to national security, and to bring its laws in line with international human rights standards.

- Nothing changes in law; the Parliament only states its opinion and makes requests.
- It concerns two jailed academics in Azerbaijan and the country's treatment of critics.
- Next, the European Union office in Baku is asked to watch the cases; the resolution goes to Azerbaijan's government and parliament.
